description:
Question. TPC-DS 4.0.0 clause 5.2.3 requires each maintenance function's refresh data set to be generated with dsdgen (dsdgen execution is not timed). Clauses 5.2.5 and 5.2.7 make loading the refresh data, including into a staging area, a timed part of the maintenance run. BenchBox's maintenance operations (benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_operations.py and maintenance_test.py) instead generate synthetic rows in Python with random values, seed the generator from int(time.time()), insert a hardcoded 10 rows per operation, and start each operation's timer before opening a connection and running initialize() (about 15 MIN/MAX dimension queries). The inner timers use time.time(). The existing item's acceptance (checksums match for a fixed seed) cannot hold while the seed is time-based.

Options.
A. Use dsdgen refresh sets (-update): generate outside the timer, load through the platform's generic loader inside the timer, run spec-defined maintenance functions. Consequence: new maintenance method; maintenance timings are not comparable with earlier BenchBox results, so results must carry a maintenance method identifier and earlier results are flagged. Needed for tpcds-qphds-spec-metric-implementation. Recommended.
B. Keep the synthetic generator and label maintenance non-official in result metadata. Consequence: no QphDS official export; tpcds-qphds-spec-metric-implementation is dropped or re-scoped.
C. Dual path: dsdgen refresh for official runs, synthetic kept behind an explicit non-official flag. Consequence: two code paths to maintain.

Evidence to prepare (agent, read-only): confirm the bundled dsdgen supports -update and what files it emits, and the refresh-set size at SF1; read the spec clause list for the data maintenance functions and map them to the current handlers; list published or retained results that contain maintenance timings and which metric inputs consume them (benchbox/core/results/metrics.py T_DM); re-read 5.2.3, 5.2.5, 5.2.7, 7.4.9.1.

Decision gate. Only the owner decides; the agent prepares the brief and then updates dependents.
